main_text.p: te mutationes, quod ad rei naturā pertinet, à tot et talibus fiunt causis: sed quòd ad nostrā cognitionem attinet, hoc non sufficit. Nempe saepius arteria quantum in se est, maximè distenditur: sed occultatur distensionis magnitudo, vel interpellatur à circunjacentiū corporum, vel obiectorū, aut numero, aut crassitie, aut duritie.
Motus si occultetur omnis, atque in omnibus arteriæ partibus:
Si in quibusdam partibus moueri arteria vi deatur, in alijs non:
Nempe de motu arteriarum, tantum animad uertitur, quantum permittunt opposita corpora.
Hinc corpulentorū pulsus, breues: graciliū, longi. Sed non æquè impediuntur latitudo & profunditas. Nempe ubi arteriarum regio-

page.notes: Printed text is set in italic in parts; the lines "Quæ arterijs obijciuntur" and "Si in quibusdam" are small roman type. The catchword and the text end are as printed. Some words in the italic lines are doubtful, notably "circunjacentiū" and "vi deatur" (printed as "moueri arteria ui deatur").
